China Railway wird bald seine Nummerierungsregeln für Züge ändern.

Laut Pressemitteilung werden Züge eingeführt, die mit X beginnen, und Z, T, K sowie nicht vorangestellte Dienste werden in Z, N und geändert V Präfixe.

Die App aktualisiert ihre Regeln wie folgt:

Jetzt zu 2026.11.25: Behalten Sie die aktuellen Regeln bei.

Für Tickets ab 2026.11.25 (geschätzt): Behalten Sie die aktuellen Regeln bei und erlauben Sie auch N und V-Präfixe.

Von 2026.12.XX: Unterstützung für X und andere neue Präfixe hinzufügen und dabei die aktuellen Regeln beibehalten. Beide Regelsätze sind bis zur nächsten Phase zulässig.

Ab 2027.01.15 (geschätzt): Entfernen Sie die alten Regeln. Möglicherweise können Sie keine Tickets mehr mit den alten Regeln generieren.

Why cannot I save a ticket?

Check required fields, a valid calendar date and 24-hour time. Prices must be positive whole or half units. Points must be positive integers ending in 00 or 50. Distance is optional; when entered it must be a positive integer. The upper limit for each is 10000000.

Current train numbers allow four digits, five digits starting with 5, or G/C/D/Z/T/K/L/Y/S followed by 1–4 digits, case insensitive. Enter one train number without renumbering or plan suffixes. Planned prefixes in important notices are not enabled rules. Points remain unchanged in saved records; the printed amount is points divided by 100. Some seat types disable the air-conditioning option; only enabled themes can be selected. History is limited to 10000 tickets. Export tickets as PNG or PDF and history as Excel through the system file picker.
What if a query fails or results differ?

Check connectivity, date and the full train or station name, then retry. Online failures may come from upstream services. Load the timetable online before using offline queries. Check offline data versions in About.

Online results depend on upstream APIs; offline lists and station boards use date-specific timetables. Cache and update times may differ. Valid delay predictions are retained until Beijing midnight when refreshes fail or return partial data; online train results can refresh delay predictions with the top-right button. Official railway information takes precedence for cancellations, delays, availability and sale changes.
How do I back up, restore or clean up storage?

Export a JSON backup in Settings and import it on the new device. Exports use password encryption by default; keep both the file and password because a forgotten password cannot be recovered. Import validates the password and file integrity before offering content selection, and still accepts legacy plaintext backups. Select at least one category; files must not exceed 28MB. Back up before uninstalling or clearing data.\n\nOpen Storage cleanup in Settings to review space and clear individual categories or all caches after confirmation. Categories include web and map cache, the Lulutong offline database, railway line cache, share images, export temporary files and test screenshots. Test screenshots appear only when files exist and disappear after cleanup.

Backups cover tickets, searches, settings, profile, visits, speed tracks, ticket drafts and availability monitor configurations. Unselected categories do not overwrite local data. Tickets merge with deduplication; visits keep the earlier visit; tracks merge by ID without replacing an existing ID. Legacy ticket-only backups restore only tickets. Permissions, notification channels, offline caches and running tasks do not migrate. Start restored monitors manually. An active recording of at least one minute can be backed up as history, without resuming location tracking.\n\nStorage cleanup keeps tickets, reminders, preferences, profile, station visits, speed tracks and quiz records. Clearing the Lulutong database also resets its memory cache; the next query requires a network connection to download it again. Clear all caches also includes this database. Test screenshot cleanup preserves backups, logs and other files. CI and production builds each manage their own app directory. Storage cleanup is separate from the system action that clears all app data.
Why did I miss an arrival notification?

Enable arrival detection in Settings and check system location, background location and notification permissions. Google Play services must be available. Allow background activity and check battery restrictions and notification channels. Accuracy, scheduling and station coverage affect detection; delivery may be delayed.

Visits use location and station geofences and do not prove a train journey. Detection uses a 300-metre radius and a 30-minute per-station notification cooldown; multilingual aliases can share one station. Records stay on the device; backup merging preserves the earlier visit and history marker.
Why did a task stop or show an inaccurate position?

Check network access, notifications and battery restrictions. Availability monitoring retries failed queries at the configured interval and stops when the query date expires. Train tracking estimates position from the timetable and available delay predictions; it is not live GPS, and upstream changes or missing data can affect the result.

Availability monitors run in a foreground service and can be stopped from the notification. Explicitly stopped or restored configurations do not restart automatically. Tracking started before arrival expires 30 minutes after scheduled arrival; tracking started at or after arrival expires after 3 minutes. Reopening the page or service does not reset expiry.
Why did a sale reminder not arrive?

Check notifications, exact alarm access, channels and the device clock. Full-screen alarms also require Do Not Disturb access and full-screen notification access where required. While using the phone, the system may show a heads-up notification; tap it to open the alarm.

Sale times use Beijing time and describe a station’s daily sale time, not a specific train’s sale date. Reminders cover only stations still awaiting sale today and fire two minutes early, or as soon as possible if less than two minutes remain. One notification combines a time slot; sent slots cannot be booked again. Today’s reservations clear at 18:00 and do not repeat tomorrow. Alarms ring for at most one minute. Revoked access falls back to ordinary notifications where possible; disabling all notifications prevents delivery.
Why is the speedometer, speed or history missing?

The entry requires system GPS hardware. Enable location and grant access; use it where reception is good. Shielded windows and tunnels can interrupt reception. Recordings with less than 60 seconds of unpaused time are not saved; exactly 60 seconds qualifies. Map tiles require connectivity; local tracks remain available if tiles fail.

Stale fixes, accuracy worse than 50 metres and obvious jumps are filtered. After 10 seconds without updates, speed is hidden while time continues; recovery joins fixes with a straight line. Pause freezes time and distance; resume starts a new segment without counting paused movement. Average speed includes stops and signal gaps in unpaused time. After process termination the last snapshot becomes history, without adding elapsed time after termination. Dial limits do not cap measured speed values.
Why are vehicle links or history missing?

Enable railfan tools in Settings. Home vehicle links apply to valid G/D/C/S trains after the train search completes. Failed train or vehicle queries may hide the link. Upstream coverage limits vehicle history; no result does not mean a vehicle never served that train.

Vehicle history shows records returned by the provider; train summaries use the timetable for the matching date. Home shows the latest record with access to full results. Vehicle search history keeps the latest 10 unique queries locally. Pull to refresh preserves results on failure. Images and liveries are identification references and do not guarantee current assignments.
How do I change appearance or report an issue?

Change language, theme and pure black mode in Settings. Layout adapts to window size; some features depend on hardware and system capabilities. Use Report an issue in About with steps, expected and actual results. Device and system details are optional; confirm publication on GitHub.

Tickets, profile and settings are stored locally; network queries contact their respective providers. Backups may contain avatars, tickets and full GPS tracks; keep them secure. Back up before clearing data or uninstalling. No desktop backend is required. Data, photographs, fonts and assets retain their source licences; see credits in About.

Welcome to
Sam-Lab CRTicket. Read these terms in full before accepting and using the app.

1. Open source and free
This app is open source and free of charge. Use, modification and redistribution of its source code must comply with the licence included in the project repository.

2. Ticket use
Tickets created, displayed or exported by this app are for personal collections, learning and souvenirs only. They are not valid railway tickets and cannot be used for travel, station entry or exit, reimbursement or identity verification. Do not use them for fraud, impersonation or other unlawful purposes. Purchase valid tickets through official channels for actual travel.

3. Mini map coverage
The mini map only covers railway operating areas in China. It may not include every line, station or recent change. Maps, station locations, train information, availability and visit records are for reference. Follow official railway information and instructions at stations.

4. Permissions
Internet access retrieves station, train, ticket availability and related service data. Location supports features you enable, including maps, speed recording and station visits; background location supports background station arrival detection. Notifications and foreground services display enabled ticket monitoring, journey tracking, speed recording, arrival and reminder status. Exact alarms, full-screen reminders and Do Not Disturb access support sale reminders you configure. Boot events restore enabled reminders and arrival tasks. Wake locks support running tasks. Import and export use the system file picker to access files you select.

Permissions are requested when needed. You may deny or revoke them in system settings; the related features may then be unavailable. Accepting these terms does not grant system permissions. Continuous location and monitoring may increase battery and data use.

5. Data and third-party services
Keep names, identity details, exported tickets and backup files secure. Hide personal details before sharing. Network queries send information required for the query to the relevant services. Third-party availability and accuracy may change. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data may delete local records. Back up as needed.

6. Responsible use
Comply with applicable laws and third-party service requirements. The app is provided as is and may contain errors or experience interruptions. Verify important travel information independently.

Selecting Agree and get started confirms that you have read and accepted these terms. Selecting Disagree and exit closes the app.

How do I play the quiz or report an incorrect question?

Enable railfan tools in Settings and open Quiz at the bottom of the tool list. A correct answer advances automatically; an incorrect choice turns red, reveals the green reference answer and provides motion and haptic feedback. The summary lists incorrect answers as statements. Use the red report icon to open a separate report page, enter a reason, then copy the question or open the project Issues form. GitHub submission is confirmed by you. The summary uses a score ring and per-question result tiles, with side-by-side results and reference answers on wide screens. A perfect score plays confetti unless system animations are disabled. Changing sets opens the first question automatically. Score cards fit their content, and action buttons follow the content in the scrolling list. Each correct answer earns 5 points. Use the share button in the summary to share a result image with your avatar and name, plus a download link through the Android share menu.

There are 20 questions per Beijing calendar day, with no repeated question in any rolling 31-day period. A daily set is saved when first opened. The same data version uses common date-based selection; network availability and current trainset records may replace some questions. Timetables and station service counts describe plans, not guaranteed actual operations. Line-distance estimates use cumulative railway mileage, not an official fare-distance database. Specific trainsets require unambiguous records dated today. Completion reopens the summary for the rest of the day. Progress stays on this device and is not included in backups. New answers record their time; old progress explicitly shows when the exact time was not recorded. Answer every question before viewing the summary; a toast shows the remaining count otherwise. The CI summary can reset progress and offer a choice of retrying the same questions or switching to a new set. Changing sets remembers questions seen today and avoids groups sharing three or more stations, trains or trainsets, including after restarting the app. Nearest-distance targets cover 100 to 5000 km in 100 km steps, with all four choices within twenty percent of the target. Nearest-duration targets cover 1 to 57 hours in one-hour steps, with all four choices within ten percent of the target. Targets with fewer than four eligible trains are skipped. Distance estimates have no fixed numerical answer rank. All travel choices stop at the origin, while only the reference train stops at the destination. City questions exclude the requested city name from all options.
How do I view line stations, mileage and reference fares?

Enable railfan tools, open Line search and choose a line by name. The page shows stations and cumulative mileage; wide windows arrange the line across several connected rows. Home search also finds railway lines. Ordinary fare calculation accepts a train number, mileage and air-conditioning type. Change the air-conditioning type to recalculate, or open the complete mileage and price table.
